issues.description: [suggestion] Voice/text meal logging: speak or type what you ate in your own words and let the coach AI parse it into a food entry, instead of only manual fields or a photo. USER PROBLEM: Add Custom Meal (src/components/nutrition/CustomMealModal.tsx) only takes manual name/calories/macro fields today -- no free-text or voice path exists (grepped: no parse/describe/freeform handling in that modal, no SpeechRecognition usage anywhere in src). Snap-to-log (photo, i-20260706-sn4p) covers the visual case but not hands-busy moments (cooking, eating out, driving) or dishes that photograph poorly (mixed thali, soup, chai+snack). Competitors (MyFitnessPal voice log, Cal AI) ship this; NYUS has neither text-freeform nor voice entry. EVIDENCE: backend already has an LLM meal-estimation path for the photo flow (llm_service.py) -- the same prompt pattern (food description -> structured items+macros) can be reused for a transcript/typed string, so this is largely a UI + one new endpoint, not new AI infra. Also ties into the in-flight i18n directive: Hindi/Hinglish speech-to-text + parsing is a natural differentiator for the India-focused base. V1 SCOPE: in the Add Custom Meal sheet, add a "Describe it" text field (mic button using the Web Speech API on web / native STT on Capacitor where available, falling back to typed text) -> POST the transcript to a new /api/v1/nutrition/parse-meal-text endpoint -> LLM returns items+macros -> prefill the existing manual fields, editable before save (same edit-then-confirm pattern already used for photo logging). No new logging surfaces, no schema changes to DailyLog. EFFORT: ~1-2 days FE (mic capture + prefill wiring reusing existing food-item form) + ~0.5 day BE (one endpoint, reuse llm_service prompt scaffolding).

issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Coach-chat outbox replay DOUBLE-PERSISTS a message when the offline gap exceeds the backend 5-min nonce-dedup TTL (or a backend restart clears the cache).

The IndexedDB message outbox re-sends a failed message carrying its ORIGINAL nonce (src/pages/_components/coach-chat/hooks/useSendMessage.tsx:190 enqueue on ack-reject; useChatOutbox.ts:31-63 replay on reconnect), and the FE EXPLICITLY relies on the server deduping that replay (chat.service.ts:427-429, useChatOutbox.ts:44-46, useSendMessage.tsx:137-139 -- "a lost ack cannot double-persist"). But the servers ONLY dedup layer is an in-process cache with a 5-minute TTL, cleared on restart (backend.py:15044 _MSG_NONCE_TTL_S=300; _msg_nonce_seen/_msg_nonce_record). Message rows have NO nonce column / unique constraint (backend.py:15180 insert), so once the cache entry is gone nothing stops a re-insert.

The outbox is designed to retry after ARBITRARY offline periods (toast: "We will retry automatically when you are back online" + IndexedDB persistence surviving app close), which routinely exceeds 5 min on mobile -- so the dedup window is far shorter than the retry window it is meant to protect.

Repro A (TTL expiry): send a coach message; drop connectivity in the ~15s window right AFTER the socket emit but AFTER the server persisted + recorded the nonce (common on mobile: background the app / lose signal). sendRealtimeMessageAck rejects -> message enqueued to outbox. Reconnect >5 min later -> replayOutbox re-sends with the same nonce -> _msg_nonce_seen misses (entry expired) -> message persisted AGAIN + re-broadcast. Expected: replay deduped to one copy. Actual: TWO identical user messages in the thread; if directed_to=ai the coach LLM ALSO runs twice (extra token cost + a 2nd AI reply to the same line).

Repro B (backend restart, even <5 min): same lost-ack enqueue, then a backend deploy/restart clears _msg_nonce_cache, then the FE reconnects and replays -> double-persist. Backend deploys are frequent (auto-deploy directive).

Root cause: dedup window (5 min, process-local, restart-volatile) << outbox retry window (arbitrary). Fix: persist the nonce to a Message.client_nonce column with a UNIQUE index on (sender_id, client_nonce) and dedupe at insert (catch IntegrityError -> ack the existing id), or back the nonce cache with a persistent store (DB/Redis) whose TTL matches the outbox lifetime. Confirmed both repos (FE useChatOutbox.ts + useSendMessage.tsx + chat.service.ts; BE backend.py handle_send_message).

fix.description: Root cause: after going offline for more than ~5 minutes (or when the backend restarted), the app's automatic message-resend could save the same coach-chat message twice — two identical messages in the thread, and for AI messages the coach even replied twice. Fix (backend): every message now carries a unique client tag enforced by a database unique index, so a resend can never create a duplicate — the server just re-confirms the existing message. Deployed and verified live on production; covered by 3 new tests.

judge.note: Root-cause fix (durable unique index + insert dedup + LLM double-run guard); deployed to prod, live schema verified, 3 tests red-before/green-after. Proof is an evidence card (backend fix has no app-screen surface).

issues.reviewReason: ROOT CAUSE FOUND + FIXED + DEPLOYED (backend commit 624589c, live on prod, health OK). The 'Failed to finalize custom plan' error was a backend 500 (BRIDGE_FAILED): _add_session_exercises inserted the client exercise_id directly, so an id orphaned by a catalog re-ingest/dedup FK-violated on flush and aborted the whole save. Fix validates the id first - an unknown id falls through to name lookup, then skip - matching the helper's documented skip-unresolvable contract; regression test added + green (5/5). Flagging instead of auto-resolving because a bar-clearing screenshot isn't safe headless: the 500 only fires when your stored plan contains an exercise_id missing from the catalog, and reproducing that on your live account would mean POSTing a bogus plan that overwrites your real one. Please retry Save plan on your device to confirm it no longer errors, then close.

fix.description: Root cause: the Activity page showed two small side-by-side 'Build Workout Plan' / 'Build Activity Plan' buttons that did not match the Diet page's 'Fine-tune your plan' hub. Fix: replaced them with a single 'Build your plan' list card mirroring the diet hub exactly - icon-square + title + subtitle + chevron rows, divide-y, same tokens (orange dumbbell for workout, teal footprints for activity). i18n added across all 4 bundles.

judge.note: Recaptured /activity shows the new BUILD YOUR PLAN card matching the diet page's row style 1:1.

fix.description: Added a 'Start automatically at' time to the recurring fasting plan (the from-time the owner asked for). When set on a repeating plan, the fast now starts automatically at that clock time each due day - back-dated so the ring is correct even if the app opens late - with no manual tap. The plan is remembered the moment the time is set, so it takes effect on the next occurrence. Manual 'Start fast until <time>' is unchanged when no start time is set. New pure helpers + 7 unit tests; a once-per-day guard prevents an early End from re-triggering.

judge.note: Config shot shows the new 'Start automatically at 10:00 AM' row + plan chip '10:00 AM -> 6:00 PM . auto'; second shot shows an overnight fast auto-started (5h38m OF 12H, ends 9:00 AM) with no tap. 25/25 fasting tests green; adversarially reviewed.

fix.description: Added a 'Daily weigh-in reminder' card on the Log Weight screen (below Body Composition): a toggle + time picker. Turning it on requests notification permission then schedules a device-local daily reminder on the existing progress_updates channel; the time picker reschedules it and the preference persists across reloads. Reuses the app's localNotifications infra (dedicated id 1031 so it never collides with the weekly weigh-in). i18n added in all 4 bundles.
